add_session.name: Add session
add_session.description: Books a charging session. The cost is calculated from the tariff now and stored; a given cost overrides the tariff.

energy_kwh.name: Energy
energy_kwh.description: Charged energy from the receipt or the provider's app.

charge_type.name: Charge type
charge_type.description: AC or DC; selects the tariff price.

tariff.name: Tariff
tariff.description: Tariff used. Required unless a cost is given.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Total amount. Overrides the tariff calculation; 0 is allowed.

timestamp.name: Time
timestamp.description: End of charging. Defaults to now.

soc_start.name: SoC start
soc_start.description: Display only, never used for costs.

soc_end.name: SoC end
soc_end.description: Display only, never used for costs.

update_session.name: Update session
update_session.description: Corrects a session, by default the vehicle's last one. Changing only the energy keeps the stored price; changing tariff or charge type uses the tariff's current price.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Session to change. Defaults to the vehicle's last session.

clear_cost.name: Clear cost
clear_cost.description: Remove a manual cost and calculate from the tariff again.

delete_session.name: Delete session
delete_session.description: Deletes a session, by default the vehicle's last one.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Session to delete. Defaults to the vehicle's last session.

list_sessions.name: List sessions
list_sessions.description: Returns sessions as response data, sorted by time.

start.name: From
start.description: Only sessions at or after this time.

end.name: Until
end.description: Only sessions at or before this time.
